name: moon-ball
effect: Used by trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the wild Pokémon is a Clefairy, Nidoran♂, Nidoran♀, Jigglypuff, Skitty, or any evolution thereof, the wild Pokémon has 4× its catch rate.
shortEffect: 4× effectiveness on familes of Pokémon with a Moon Stone evolution. Made from Ylw Apricorn.

flavorTextEntries.text: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that evolve using the Moon Stone.
A Poké Ball that will make it easier to catch Pokémon that can evolve using a Moon Stone.
